purpose: Follow-up on the broad exact-name sweep for Cayley, recording that the 308 recent local Cayley names are not public completion evidence and should remain salvage/source-witness/provenance unless exact page ranges are independently re-audited.

decisions.decision: Do not promote any Cayley range as source-faithful from these exact-name misses. User spot-checks found substantial symbol/text mismatches in Volume I material, so current Cayley reader PDFs, TeX slices, page micro-ZIPs, unitized indexes, and salvage packages are repair/provenance/source-comparison material only until a future page-by-page glyph/source audit re-promotes exact ranges.
Filenames containing source_checked are legacy working labels, not public certification. Keep as possible page-local repair evidence; do not treat as a Volume I completion claim.
Index snapshots through Vol. I pages/notes are alignment aids and anti-regression material, not proof that underlying TeX is faithful.
Combined suspect draft and 15 chunk ZIPs are explicitly suspect handoff material for Pro/local repair, not reader-facing artifacts.
Internet Archive JP2 source-scan ZIPs and mixed handoff packages are source/provenance material. They can support future audit but do not improve current reader status by themselves.

representative_inspections.inspection: Audit says public reader PDFs exist for Volumes I-XIII and broad TeX coverage exists, but the corpus is not complete faithful modern TeX. Major problems remain dense tables, plates, diagrams, long coefficient displays, placeholder/facsimile language, and source-scan packaging gaps. Public reader inventory totals 5,714 pages with 18 residual marker hits; zero marker hits do not prove source-faithfulness.

Audit rejects the Claude cayley_vol_i_clean per-paper folder as structurally corrupt: 481-page full reader but 1,734 total per-paper PDF pages, duplicate paper IDs, body-file concatenation/front-matter leakage, middle-of-content starts, remaining placeholders, and weak provenance labels. Do not publish/promote as a clean Volume I per-paper edition.

Cleanup packet rules remain correct: no screenshots as substitutes, no silent summaries/removals of hard math, preserve source-page anchors, and mark unrepaired passages explicitly as localized unresolved witnesses.

Earlier cleanup target note records 18 public-reader marker hits on 15 pages and numerous source marker hits, especially in Volume II tables/figures. This reinforces that source markers and placeholders must be resolved before promotion.

public_facing_caveats_to_keep: Cayley is currently provenance/repair/salvage material, not an accurate or complete edition.
No Cayley range should be called source-faithful unless a future per-page glyph/source audit explicitly re-promotes that exact range.
Legacy filenames containing Complete, critical, source_checked, or working_complete are not current quality claims.
Unitized indexes and page micro-ZIPs are repair aids; source scans are provenance; neither alone establishes faithfulness.
The current Cayley record should be useful for future repair and reproducibility, but readers must verify equations/tables/diagrams against source scans before using it.
next_actions: If Cayley work resumes, start with exact source pages, produce page-local diffable TeX, and require glyph/formula/table comparison before promotion.
Do not loose-upload the 308 local exact-name misses; curate only a future compact salvage/provenance rollup if needed.
